verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub organization (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), and a probe confirms it is documented there, so an agent can connect to Elasticsearch through a first-party MCP server. The evidence only establishes that the server exists, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of exposed tools and capabilities, setup and auth configuration details, transport or hosted-endpoint options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of it working with agents.
